open_obligations.obstruction: The frozen population Gaussianization result supplies neither uniform anti-concentration nor an observable common-multiplier coupling through variance degeneracy. At the corrected resolutions, the available pilot bounds do not imply the relative Hilbert--Schmidt spectral consistency needed to replace the population quadratic quantile, and the sufficient covariance condition can fail for parameter values allowed by the model class.
open_obligations.attempted: Calibrate the exact estimator expansion by the population Gaussian--quadratic proxy, pad its quantile by bounded--Lipschitz approximation error, and absorb the corrected pilot remainder by its uniform \(L^2\) envelope. This proves an infeasible interval of the desired order. The exact \(d=0\) uniform-null law also yields an observable chaos-quantile interval on that single submodel. Replacing the positive-dimensional population kernel, covariance, and local shifts by their observed analogues was then attempted using the frozen operator and covariance controls; the explicit allowed case \(d=1\), \(s_y=1/10\), \(s_z=1\) violates the covariance growth premise and makes the generic relative spectral-error envelope diverge. The no-covariate null critical value has no proved uniform coupling to local and fixed unequal laws.
